wizard.welcomeTitle: A research companion that learns what you care about

wizard.maps: It builds a map of the companies and ideas you follow.

notice.title: Before you start
notice.body: Loupist is an AI research tool. When you ask, your Loupist can share its own view on an investment, but it can be wrong, it isn't a licensed financial adviser, and it never places trades. Your decisions and their results are yours.

tone.title: How should {{name}} talk?
tone.note: Tone changes how your Loupist talks, not the evidence it needs.

careful.label: Careful
careful.description: States uncertainty first, adds caveats and explains terms.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Research language; explains a term the first time it appears.

direct.label: Direct
direct.description: Leads with its view, with fewer caveats and expert vocabulary.
